questions.q: What is Holmes' opinion of the woman he refers to in the story?
choices: eclipses the whole of her sex
questions.explain: The woman is more important to Holmes than other women.

questions.q: How does Holmes view the softer passions, like love and emotion?
questions.explain: Holmes avoids softer passions to maintain his logical and precise mind.

questions.q: What is the reason Holmes and the woman in the story are not in touch anymore?
choices: Holmes was busy with his work
questions.explain: Holmes' marriage caused a distance between him and the woman.

questions.q: What was Holmes' opinion of women in general?
questions.explain: Holmes avoided softer passions as they could interfere with his balanced reasoning.

questions.q: Who did Holmes consider to be the most important woman in his life?
questions.explain: Irene Adler was the only woman Holmes truly considered in his life.

questions.q: What did Holmes find problematic about his marriage?
choices: it was too close to Holmes' work
it made him focus on home and family
it gave him too much free time to think
it made him doubt his reasoning abilities
questions.explain: Holmes felt his marriage made him focus on his home and family, which took attention away from his work.
